content:
Right after snagging AirPods Pro 3 at one of their lowest prices ever, fall Prime Day deals are rolling in across the latest Mac lineup. Our brand new M6 Mac mini configurations have hit all-time lows with up to nearly $150 off, and the 2026 Mac Studio is seeing close to $200 in discounts.

Beyond those deals, nearly every M5 MacBook Air model is $200 off, the M5 Pro MacBook Pro continues to carry a $500 discount, Apple's brand-new minimalist full-character Magic Keyboard is on sale for the first time, and the Magic Mouse is also on rare sale.

If you're looking at the MacBook lineup, fall Prime Day is bringing the lowest prices in months on Apple's M5 MacBook Air series. Amazon is currently offering a straight $200 off almost every configuration, with most also available in multiple colors:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (originally $1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,399 (originally $1,599)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,599 (originally $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,299 (originally $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,599 (originally $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,799 (originally $1,999)

Amazon has rolled out several major price drops on Apple's brand-new Mac mini lineup this morning. From the entry-level M6 configuration all the way up to the high-end model with M5 Max, we're now tracking up to $149 off — the lowest prices ever recorded:

  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/256GB $780 (originally $899) — all-time low
  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/512GB $950 (originally $1,099) — all-time low
  • 2026 M5 Max Mac mini 24GB/512GB $1,550 (originally $1,699) — all-time low

Beyond those deals, the new Mac Studio with 36GB of RAM has also hit an all-time low, with Amazon taking $199 off — the best price we've seen since it went on sale last month:

  • 2026 M5 Max Mac Studio $2,300 (originally $2,499) — all-time low

While we're still waiting on (and hoping for) more MacBook Pro deals, Amazon is still offering $500 off this upgraded 2TB configuration — a discount that brings the price $100 below its pre-increase MSRP:

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,699 (originally $3,199)

On top of all that, we're also tracking several discounts on Apple Mac accessories. Specifically, the Magic Mouse in both black and white is on rare sale with up to nearly 25% off, while Apple's brand-new Magic Keyboard with a minimalist full-character key design — which Apple launched just recently — is also seeing its first discount:

  • Apple Magic Keyboard (brand-new 2026 model) $80 (originally $99)
  • Apple Magic Mouse in white $60 (originally $79)
  • Apple Magic Mouse in black $80 (originally $99)
